p_live: Published to the store. Refresh the store if it has not changed within a minute.
p_imgsNote: Upload from your phone or computer and it goes live after you save, or paste an https link. First image is main · ★ main · arrows reorder · ✕ delete. Max 5.
p_imgsPrep: Uploading the photo to the store…
p_imgsAdded: Photo uploaded. Save the product so everyone sees it.
p_imgsFail: Could not upload the photo. Try again.
p_imgsFull: Device storage full — fewer images or publish first
p_listNote: Tap Full edit for stock, photos, description and how-to-use.
p_invNote: Quantities publish with products. Customers see out-of-stock after Publish. Stock drops automatically when an order is set to Preparing.
p_imgsNeedLogin: Sign in first, then upload the photo.
p_imgsNeedStorage: Upload needs Firebase Storage enabled once. An https link works without it.
p_imgsUrlBad: The link must start with https.
